summary: This bill aims to prevent Medicare fraud related to durable medical equipment by requiring electronic submission of claims for certain medical equipment and supplies and mandating that these claims be submitted within 90 days of the service date.

scores.thoughts: This bill aims to improve Medicare program integrity by preventing fraud related to durable medical equipment (DME). By tightening claim submission rules and requiring electronic submissions for certain items, it seeks to ensure that Medicare funds are used appropriately, which directly impacts the efficiency and sustainability of this public healthcare program.
